headlines.title: Trump, campaigning in Ohio, says the midterms will bring a ‘big surprise’
headlines.description: VANDALIA, Ohio — President Donald Trump rallied Saturday for Republicans in Ohio’s competitive races for Senate and governor, predicting that the party will defy expectations in a choppy midterm election climate.

headlines.title: Ken Paxton’s estranged wife urges voters to back his Senate bid, yet avoids mentioning him by name
headlines.description: The estranged wife of Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton urged voters to stand behind the entire Republican midterm ticket in an ad released Saturday, though she neglected to name Paxton directly.

headlines.title: Can Democrats Mess With (Republican) Texas?
headlines.description: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D-TX) says the economy and jobs are more important than culture issues in the race for Texas Governor

headlines.title: U.S. Marine arrested on suspicion of killing Japanese woman in Okinawa
headlines.description: A United States service member is in custody on suspicion of killing a Japanese national on the island of Okinawa.

headlines.title: New revelations in Cornell rape investigation
headlines.description: We’re seeing dramatic video of a confrontation with one of the men accused in the Cornell sexual assault case. This as questions grow over how the alleged 2024 incident was handled. NBC News’ Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Urgent race to find missing medical evacuation jet
headlines.description: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for a Gulfstream jet carrying six people that lost contact with flight controllers early Saturday morning on its way to Boston from the island of Bermuda. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch has the latest.

headlines.title: Taylor Swift pops into ‘SNL’ to joke around with host Dakota Johnson
headlines.description: Pop music icon Taylor Swift made a surprise appearance on “Saturday Night Live,” joining her friend and the episode’s host, Dakota Johnson, for some laughs.

headlines.title: Inside Walmart's push to win fashion shoppers with $25-and-under looks, new bohemian brand
headlines.description: With Target struggling and Amazon's essentials in the mix, Walmart is pushing fashion to gain market share. With new brand Scenario's under-$25 looks, the retailer aims to shift perceptions of "cheap" to chic value. NBC News' Allie Canal reports.

headlines.title: New details about co-pilot after Flydubai incident
headlines.description: A Flydubai pilot attacked his flight captain using a crash ax and tried to take control of the aircraft’s controls in an attempted terrorist attack, an official with the United Arab Emirates said Saturday. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: Global tech policymakers agree to embrace AI in science
headlines.description: The U.S. plans to release a joint statement with 15 other countries describing a shared vision for a “golden age of science” that embraces artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Mike Tomlin gives fans a glimpse inside the Minecraft city he spent 12 years building
headlines.description: For 12 years, the former Pittsburgh Steelers coach has been devoted to building a single map in the video game. On Wednesday, he showed it off for the first time.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
